name: Card Ordering & Delivery
definition: Requests for new, replacement, or virtual cards, and inquiries regarding delivery status or eligibility.

name: Lost or Stolen Card
definition: Reporting a card as lost, stolen, stuck in an ATM, or damaged to request a block or replacement.

name: Fraud & Unauthorized Transactions
definition: Reporting unrecognized transactions, suspicious activity, or suspected unauthorized account access.

name: Card Activation & Settings
definition: Requests to activate a card, unblock a frozen card, or manage card features like contactless.

name: PIN Management
definition: Requests to view, change, reset, or unblock a card PIN.

name: Card Usage & Acceptance
definition: Inquiries about where a card is accepted, ATM availability, or general usage capabilities.

name: Card Payment Declined
definition: Issues where a card transaction or withdrawal is rejected or fails to process.

name: Top-Up Issues
definition: Problems with adding funds to the account, including failed, reverted, or pending top-ups.

name: Transfer & Withdrawal Status
definition: Inquiries regarding the status, failure, or non-arrival of transfers and cash withdrawals.

name: Transaction Disputes & Refunds
definition: Requests to dispute a charge, report incorrect amounts, or process refunds and cancellations.

name: Fees, Limits, & Exchange Rates
definition: Questions regarding account fees, transaction limits, exchange rates, or specific charges.

name: Account Access & Login
definition: Issues with logging in, passwords, passcodes, or account security access.

name: Identity Verification
definition: Inquiries about the identity verification process, document requirements, or source of funds checks.

name: Account Management
definition: Requests to update personal details, close an account, or manage account settings.

name: General Information
definition: General how-to questions about app features, top-up methods, and transfers.
